usage: ‘蒙古’ is used as a noun to refer to the country Mongolia.
You can use ‘蒙古’ as the subject or object in a sentence when talking about this country.
When mentioning ‘蒙古’, you often pair it with verbs like 去 (go), 來 (come), or 旅行 (travel).
The word ‘蒙古’ does not change form for singular or plural contexts.
It is common to see ‘蒙古’ in discussions about geography, culture, or travel.
